'''Business and economy'''
*[[2026 Bangladesh garment workers protests]]
**Several [[Textile industry in Bangladesh|garment factories]] in [[Gazipur]], [[Bangladesh]] declare holidays amid ongoing [[minimum wage]] protests, as clashes erupt between [[working class|workers]] and [[Bangladesh Police|police]] along the [[N3 (Bangladesh)|Dhaka–Mymensingh Highway]], with workers throwing bricks and police firing [[tear gas]] and [[stun grenade]]s while [[Special Response Battalion]], [[Bangladesh Ansar|Ansar]], [[Border Guard Bangladesh|BGB]], and [[Industrial Police (Bangladesh)|Industrial Police]] personnel deploy to the area. [https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/garment-workers-stage-fresh-protest-gazipur-attempt-block-dhaka-mymensingh-highway (''The Business Standard'')]
**[[Border Guard Bangladesh]] deploys 95 [[platoon]]s across seven districts, including two [[battalion]]s in [[Gopalganj District, Bangladesh|Gopalganj]], stepping up [[surveillance]] at key installations and industrial zones using [[unmanned aerial vehicle|drone]]s and [[police body camera]]s. [https://www.thedailystar.net/news/crime-justice/news/bgb-deploys-95-platoons-across-seven-districts-maintain-law-and-order-4330136 (''The Daily Star'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2026 United Nations Climate Change Conference]]
**The 2026 [[United Nations Climate Change Conference]] (COP31) in [[Antalya]], [[Turkey]], concludes without a final agreement after countries failed to reach consensus on [[fossil fuel]] policies. It is the longest climate summit on record. [https://www.afp.com/en/climate-talks-collapse-chaotic-end-cop31 (AFP)] [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/cop/cop31-climate-talks-close-final-deal-says-summit-president-2026-11-21/ (Reuters)]
